products.title: DeepCool ASSASSIN IV VC VISION CPU Air Cooler
products.body_html:
ASSASSIN IV VC VISION

DeepCool's flagship air cooler series gets a drastic addition in the form of the ASSASSIN IV VC VISION. The cooling capacity gets a nice bump with the inclusion of a vapor chamber at the base that pushes the TDP to 300W! The upgrades don't stop there, as a high-end quad-segmented digital display has also been added to the already impressive ASSASSIN IV cooler. An aesthetical cooling powerhouse that has two sound profiles and a digital screen—air coolers can have it all.

VAPOR CHAMBER-ENHANCED
Vapor chambers are essentially large, flattened heatpipes with high thermal conductance. In the ASSASSIN IV VC series, the heat is extracted through the coldplate, which starts the cooling process in the planar chamber. The heat gets equalized and sent up the heatpipes to get cooled further by the fin stacks. This solution raises the cooling capacity to an astounding 300W of TDP!

THE DIGITAL TOUCH
The standout addition of the ASSASSIN IV VC VISION is the enhanced quad-segmented display that monitors the temperature, usage, wattage, and frequency of your CPU. The digital panel is magnetized, so installation and adjustments are extremely simple. The display is controlled via DeepCool software and only requires an open USB 2.0 header.

VISUAL TEMPERATURE ALERTS
A temperature warning alert system has been integrated with a color-coded visual thermometer indicator: under 80 °C, the indicator will stay green; between 80 °C and 90 °C, it will be a bright orange; when things get warm above 90 °C, it will go red, and you will start to see flashes.
*Due to variances in hardware configurations, polling periods, and system settings, the displayed information may experience minor delays.
*CPU temperature based on Intel: CPU Package / AMD: CPU Tdie

IN QUIET OR PERFORMANCE MODE
With a simple slide of a switch, the ASSASSIN IV VC VISION can morph from a whisper-quiet cooler when low noise is of the utmost importance to the efficient cooling force DeepCool air coolers are known for.

ALL CLEAR!
The ASSASSIN IV VC VISION's case is clean, sleek, and helps channel air through the fin towers, while the relocatable 120mm fan provides unobstructed clearance for high-profile RGB RAM.
RAM Clearance:

  • Intel LGA1851/1700/1200/115X: Unobstructed
  • Intel LGA20XX: 63mm
  • AMD: AM4/AM5: Unobstructed

BE COOL, BE CALM
A key factor in the ASSASSIN IV VC VISION's extremely silent operation is the use of three-phase, six-slot, four-pole fan motors with low voltage and power consumption. The high-end true FDB bearings in each of the fans are the gold standard, and for good reason. DeepCool is so confident in our new design that the ASSASSIN IV VC VISION comes with 6 years of limited warranty coverage!

products.body_html:
AN600 Low-Profile CPU Air Cooler

The AN600 is a low-profile CPU cooler that provides 180W of cooling to the CPU while also cooling the RAM modules. Making full use of a 120mm high airflow fan and an overhanging design, the AN600 actively cools RAM modules up to 40mm tall, while being compatible with ITX motherboards.

Keeping Things Cool
Utilizing 62 aluminum fins, a slim profile 120mm fan, 6 optimized heatpipes, and a raised copper coldplate, the AN600 packs a lot of cooling potential in a short 67mm tall CPU cooler.

More Than A CPU Cooler
Taking full advantage of the slim 120mm PWM-enabled FDB fan and a top-down air flow, the AN600 pushes massive amounts of air through the fin array and down onto the RAM and VRMs below. The visible three-phase, six-slot, four pole fan motor ensures all of this is accomplished while staying under 24.4 dB(A).

Simplified Support
The all-metal back plate is easy to install and evenly distributes pressure from the rear of the motherboard, while providing reinforcement behind the CPU socket.
